complete_examples.text: Ignoring the high-order components of the fluctuating winds, the quasi-steady wind forces can be divided into two parts: the steady-state forces caused by the average wind speed U and the buffering forces caused by the unsteady wind velocity or the fluctuating wind The steady-state forces acting on the car body of the vehicle can be divided into three components in general, that is, side force, lift force and rolling moment, as defined in Equation (21), respectively.
